output.summary: Annual flowering plant whose native origin is unresolved in the supplied information. Its female flower heads become buoyant, hooked burs that catch in animal hair. Small amounts of mature plant parts may be consumed, but seeds and seedlings should not be eaten in large quantities because they contain an extremely toxic chemical.
output.edibilityNote: Small amounts of mature parts may be consumed; seeds, seedlings and large quantities are dangerous, and famine consumption caused deaths in Bangladesh in 2007.
